messages:
Anjali (Product): Quick sync — we need to lock the private deploy roadmap slice for customer-managed networking + upgrade paths. Top asks: zero-downtime upgrades, egress IP preservation, and an airgap/offline install mode. Propose we prioritize: 1) operator-shim for in-cluster upgrades, 2) offline bundle + installer for airgapped customers, 3) egress-ip pinning and canary routes for netops. Thoughts?

Marco (Eng): Operator-shim sounds like the right path: minimal footprint, keeps control-plane thin. Estimate 3-4w for spike + tests. Main unknown: cert rotation without outbound.

Jamie (Field): +1 from field. Large financials asked specifically for IP-preserve and a rollback path. They hate double-write canaries.

Ben (Solutions): Blue/green is easiest for rollback but doubles infra cost. Could we do a hybrid: canary routes + storm-limited traffic shift? That gives rollback without full double capacity.

Carla (Security): Requirements: KMS/HSM option for key material, end-to-end audit logs, and an explicit "no-telemetry" toggle for airgap. Also need an approval flow for operator upgrades.

Marco (Eng): For the cert rotation problem we can add an agent-side CSR signer flow. Rough idea: agent holds private key, opens ephemeral CSR via customer-approved webhook, control-plane returns signed cert. Works offline if webhook proxied through customer relay.

Anjali (Product): Nice. That suggests two implementation tracks: "online-friendly operator-shim" and "relay-enabled offline flow". We should also spec an operator-mode toggle (managed vs customer-network) so customers can opt to manage routing.

Jamie (Field): Please include explicit rollback migration steps in the spec: sequence for config rollback, how we reassign egress IPs, and metrics to watch. Field will validate against top 6 customers.

Ben (Solutions): I'll model cost delta for canary routes vs full blue/green and add a SLA impact note.

Carla (Security): Also add threat model for operator-shim: attack surface if customer enables external webhooks. Include mitigations: mTLS + signed payloads + short-lived certs.

deploy-bot: Deploy config draft uploaded: https://redwood.example/internal/privdeploy/packaging-spike (internal)

Anjali (Product): Action items: Marco — 2-week spike to surface feasibility and a spec PR. Ben — cost model and tradeoffs. Jamie — collect top-5 customer scenarios and rollback constraints. Carla — draft security checklist (KMS/HSM, telemetry toggle, webhook auth). Target: spec PR + spike results by EOD next Thu. :calendar:

Marco (Eng): Ack. I'll open the spike branch and initial spec PR today.

Ben (Solutions): Ack — will share link to sheet by Tue.

Jamie (Field): Pinged ACME + Globex for scenarios. Will post notes here when I get responses.

Anjali (Product): Thanks all. We'll review spike outcomes and decide which lane to ship in the Q3 roadmap. If anyone needs a reprioritization, flag it here. :thumbsup:
